name: Supreme Court of India: Judgments by Date
summary: Answer the CAPTCHA on a form left open by sci/judgements-open, search, and read every result page.
description: Second half of a judgment-date search. Runs in the tab sci/judgements-open left on the filled form: types captcha_answer, presses Search, waits for results, reads each row, clicks the site pagination links for further pages, and returns rows plus the raw HTML of each result page. status is ok, empty, captcha_wrong or error; complete is false when paging ran out of time. Driven in bulk by scripts/sci/sci-listing.sh.

captcha_answer.description: Answer to the CAPTCHA shown by sci/judgements-open.

steps.name: Check the filled form is still open
Read every result page through the site pagination

rows_json.description: JSON array of rows: [{ pdf_url, petitioner, respondent, case_number, diary_number, decision_date, listed_text, cells_json, all_links, page }]. A string because the result serializer cuts arrays to 50 items.

help.summary: Answer the CAPTCHA, search and read every result page. Run after sci/judgements-open.

parameters.captcha_answer: Answer to the CAPTCHA image from sci/judgements-open.

examples.description: Search the window opened by sci/judgements-open

returns: Object: { status, message, complete, page_count, row_count, rows_json, pages_html: [string] }. rows_json is a JSON array string of { pdf_url, petitioner, respondent, case_number, diary_number, decision_date, listed_text, cells_json, all_links, page }.
notes: Must run in the tab sci/judgements-open left open; the site keeps one parked tab per system.
Each new search needs a new CAPTCHA. Paging reuses the site pagination nonce, so it needs none.
Use scripts/sci/sci-listing.sh for the 2014-to-today backlog and the weekly window.
